description: Rename, move to another bin, set the label colour of, or delete project items (bins, clips, sequences). Changes are one undo step

delete.description: Remove the items from the project. Default false

items.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

label.description: Label colour by index, 0-15, as in Edit > Label

moveTo.description: Move into this bin (moveToRoot for the project root)

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

selected.description: Also act on the items selected in the Project panel

name: manage_items
title: Manage Items
